description: Born from the fusion of BioMicelio and Prodigios, we are one team of young Amazonian innovators. BioMicelio, national champion of INNOVaiLAB, contributes biocommerce and AI-driven mushroom tourism through MicoRuta Pastaza. Prodigios, second place in Expo Clean's Challenge 5, contributes computer vision and prototyping through JaguAR. Together, we turn biodiversity, business thinking and artificial intelligence into sustainable solutions for the Amazon.
